y_true.description: The ground truth values. `y_true` values are expected to be -1 or 1. If binary (0 or 1) labels are provided we will convert them to -1 or 1 with shape = `[batch_size, d0, .. dN]`.

y_pred.description: The predicted values with shape = `[batch_size, d0, .. dN]`.

output.description: Squared hinge loss values with shape = `[batch_size, d0, .. dN-1]`.
